card.name: Dose amounts and limits wording
card.fires_on: Words and digits inside dosing instructions that describe amounts, such as excessive, concentrations, number, limits, doses, or a digit in a dose or duration. It appears in dosage sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Dose-quantity words
modes.description: Nouns or adjectives about dose amounts or limits in dosing text.
modes.example: Other volumes and<< concentrations>> may be used provided the total maximum recommended

modes.label: Digits in doses
modes.description: A digit within a dose, rate or number of divided doses or weeks.
modes.example: romolar; then <<1>>5 mg IV q 3 hours until

modes.label: Partial dose words
modes.description: The start or middle of words like dosage or doses.
modes.example: Dos<<age>> recommendations for patients with severe hepatic impairment
